claim_map.title: Historical manual-netting contract
claim_map.text: The historical agreement permits netting/un-netting before Razor in Projected, Queued, Pending, and Validated. It requires preview, common entity/counterparty/currency/value date, GUI and backend validation, and a different checker. Components become Netted; resultant starts Queued and requires NSTP review before Validated. Un-net kills the resultant and restores components to Queued. Unhandled resultants become Failed on value date; failed accounting and rounding remain open. Product is first-component derived. Prose12 versus mapping16 resultant-ID width conflicts. Current manual-netting candidate already retains these scoped rules and conflicts.
